name: Laguna Lakeside Residences
developer: Banyan Group Residences (Laguna Resorts & Hotels / Laguna Property)
shortDescription: Low-rise lagoon-view condominiums of 1 to 3 bedrooms at the entrance to Laguna Phuket, 0.7 km from Boat Avenue.
description:
Laguna Lakeside Residences is a group of low-rise condominium blocks beside a lagoon at the entrance to the Laguna Phuket resort community in Bang Tao. Its newer extension, Laguna Lake Residences Aster, is sold separately as the next phase and has its own page. Its July 2024 release describes four blocks of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, each with its own rooftop infinity pool, set in landscaped gardens. The first block was completed in June 2024; the developer launched further blocks next to it in July 2024.
FazWaz lists 114 units, with one-bedroom units of about 40 to 52 sqm and two-bedroom units of about 56 to 85 sqm. Shared facilities listed there include a communal pool, spa, gym, cafe, lobby and 24-hour security with CCTV. Boat Avenue, the area's shopping and dining street, is about 0.7 km away in a straight line.
The sources disagree on the building layout (one building of seven floors on the portal, four low-rise blocks according to the developer), so we do not state a single building count. The July 2024 launch price of THB 9 million may be out of date; ask us for current availability.

researchNotes: Name: Banyan Group uses "Laguna Lakeside Residences"; FazWaz lists "Laguna Lakeside". Distinct from Skypark Elara Lakelands and Laguna Lakeview Residences (other Banyan projects). Developer naming differs by source: Banyan Group Residences (press release), Laguna Property (FazWaz, Hipflat), Laguna Grande Limited (Hutton's), Laguna Resorts and Hotels (DDProperty). Units: FazWaz 114, Hipflat 31. Building: FazWaz 1 building / 7 floors, Banyan four low-rise blocks. Ownership not verified. Unit sizes from FazWaz listings. | Images 2026-11-25: 12 renders from banyangroupresidences.com/thailand/phuket/laguna-lake-residences-aster (page title still "Laguna Lakeside Residences"; image files named "LLR Aster"). No watermarks. Official page: 7-storey condominium, 1-3 bedrooms, rooftop infinity pool, near Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. Page marketed as Laguna Lake Residences Aster: treated as the same Lakeside Residences project (page title and image file names match); confirm with Banyan. | Banyan's project page for this name redirects to "Laguna Lake Residences Aster"; the two are treated as the same development, to be confirmed with Banyan. 2026-11-27: Banyan Group describes Laguna Lake Residences Aster as an extension of the sold-out Laguna Lakeside Residences; the two are kept as separate pages (phases), cross-linked via relatedProjects. Earlier sentence saying Aster is the same project was corrected.
